# UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer suppressions for the Windows sanitizer tests
# (test-windows-sanitizers in workflows/build-and-test.yml). Only for
# third-party code: the backend's own reports are fixed, not suppressed.

# LibreSSL (built from source on Windows only; Linux and macOS use the
# system OpenSSL). sk_pop_free() calls each element's free function
# through a generic void (*)(void*) pointer. Undefined by the letter of
# the standard (-fsanitize=function), harmless on every ABI we build for,
# and freedv-gui suppresses it too.
function:crypto/stack/stack.c
